title: Parse a CSV Record
prompt: Implement `item_price(record)`, `item_qty(record)`, and `item_name(record)` for records shaped `"pen,2.5,120"` — name is text, price a double, qty an int.

tests.name: spaces in name
tests.hint: Names contain spaces — >> would stop at the first one; getline(row, out, ',') does not.
